_comment: Section champions by season, as the ladder crowns them (ladder.kavasocialchessclub.com). Copied here so the site builds without the ladder repo. Add a season when it ends. Seasons 1 to 7 were reconstructed from the club's game records. 'battles' is for club-against-club results: {date, title, result}.

battles.title: Battle for the Bay, at Tampa Knights
battles.result: Tampa Knights won the match. For Kava Social: Maddie, Best Female Player; Toska, section winner and Best Rookie; Ben beat a National Master on board one.
battles.result_es: Tampa Knights ganó el match. Por Kava Social: Maddie, Mejor Jugadora; Toska, ganador de su sección y Mejor Novato; Ben le ganó a un Maestro Nacional en el tablero uno.
